name: Data Engineering Basic
summary: Python 3.12 workspace with PostgreSQL 16 and JupyterLab for SQL and batch-pipeline projects.

services.name: workspace
services.purpose: Your development container: Python 3.12 and JupyterLab

services.name: postgres
services.purpose: Relational database with a small sample dataset

reset.label: Reset the sample database
reset.command: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait

limitations: PostgreSQL is not published to your machine by default; connect from the workspace (host `postgres`).
Sample data is small and synthetic.
